exercises.question: Evaluate: lim (x->3) (x² - 9) / (x - 3).
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Factor numerator: (x - 3)(x + 3).\n2. Cancel common factor (x - 3) since x approaches 3 but is not equal to 3.\n3. Evaluate lim (x->3) (x + 3) = 3 + 3 = 6.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Factor numerator: (x - 3)(x + 3).\n2. Cancel common factor (x - 3) since x approaches 3 but is not equal to 3.\n3. Evaluate lim (x->3) (x + 3) = 3 + 3 = 6.
